message.content: {"facts": ["Pet food nutritional values are determined by a combination of laboratory analysis and feeding trials.", "Feeding trials involve feeding the pet food to animals and monitoring their health and well-being.", "Pet food companies, including Pedigree, conduct feeding trials to ensure the quality of their products.", "High-quality pet food brands include hill's science diet, royal canin, orijen, acana, blue buffalo, wellness, and taste of the wild.", "Consultation with a veterinarian is recommended to determine the specific nutritional needs of the pet."]}
